title: UI整体设计粗糙且缺乏用户友好性
description: 界面外观丑陋、布局杂乱、可读性差，整体缺乏用户友好设计，影响使用体验。
evidence: UI is ugly as sin.  I am a fan of ASCII games and can tolerate pain.  Everything looks like a working prototype that was made by someone who wished they were working on something else.
everything's got 500 menus, all of them are just bare menus with no user friendly design
Interface had almost no possitive or helpful changes

evidence_items.quote: some contain default Unity slide bars and fully black backgrounds (see refuel UI), many other UIs look out of place and have many different styles

evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些包含默认的Unity滑动条和全黑背景（见加油界面），许多其他界面则显得格格不入，并且风格各异
